caseno: Appeal from original decree No. 9 of 1986.
lawyer:
Mr. Khondker Mahbub Hossain with Mr. Khondker Gulzar Hossain, Advocates ----- For the Appellant.
Mr. SA Rahim, Advocate ----- For Respondent Nos.1-4
parties:
Fazlul Karim ----- Appellant.
Vs.
Agrani Bank, represented by the Chairman, Board of Directors, Agrani Bank and ors ----- Respondents.
full_judgment:
Md. Ismailuddin Sarker, J.: This appeal by the plaintiff-appellant is against the judgment and decree dated 24.11.85 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge and Commercial Court No. 1 Dhaka in Title Suit No. 43 of 1984 dismissing the suit. 

 2. The plaintiff-appellant instituted the aforesaid suit against the Agrani Bank and 4 others of its officials for a declaration that (a) that the office order bearing Memo No. AGM/DAD/2028/82 dated 29th November, 1982 dismissing the plaintiff from the service is malafide, illegal, void, inoperative and against the principle of natural justice and (b) for a decree declaring that the plaintiff is still in service under the defendants on the allegations, inter alia, that the appellant joined the then Habib Bank Limited as an Officer on 21.5.68 and he was absorbed in the Agrani Bank after liberation of Bangladesh when the Habib Bank Limited was Nationalised under Bangladesh Bank (Nationalisation) Order 1972 (PO 26 of 1972) and ultimately he was promoted to the rank of Senior Principal Officer of the Agrani Bank on 1.2.82; that while he was in service he received a charge-sheet dated 29.7.81 containing certain allegations against him relating to the period of his service as Sub-Manager in the Department of Foreign Exchange Branch from 27.7.79 to 29.7.81, to show cause why disciplinary action including dismissal from service should not be taken against him with information to submit his explanation to the defendant No. 4 who was appointed Inquiry Officer within 7 days; that the appellant submitted his explanation to the Inquiry Officer denying the charges levelled against him on 15th August, 1981; that the Inquiry Officer submitted a report without any proper enquiry against the appellant in violation of the provisions of the Agrani Bank (Employees) Service Regulations, 1981 and that on the basis of the report of the Inquiry Officer the appellant was dismissed from his service by an order dated 29.11.82 communicated to him by the defendant No. 5. The further case of the appellant was that before the passing of the order of dismissal of the appellant from service he was neither supplied with a copy of the inquiry report nor he was asked to show cause against the penalty proposed to be inflicted on him in violation of Regulation 28(II)(e) of the said Regulations, 1981 and as such the order of dismissal was without any legal authority. Hence the suit 

 7. In a suit instituted against the Secretary of State for India challenging the validity of an order removing the plaintiff from the Indian Civil Service it has been observed by the Judicial Committee of the, Privy Council in the case of High Commissioner for India and another Vs. IM Lall reported in AIR 1948 Privy Council, 121 same as 52 CWN 761 (PC) that the proper declaration in such a suit should be the "a declaration that the order of 10th August, 1940, purporting to dismiss the respondent from the Indian Civil Service was void and inoperative and that the respondent remained a member of the Indian Civil Service at the date of the institution of the present action on 20th July, 1942." Following the aforesaid decision of the Privy Council Cornelius, J, as his Lordship then was, sitting in a Single Bench of the Lahore High Court in the case of Yusaf Ali Khan Vs. The Province of the Punjab reported in PLD 1949 Lahore, 219 decreed a similar suit making a declaration in favour of the plaintiff that the order of dismissal from his service of the Provincial Government was void and inoperative and that he remained in service at the date of institution of the suit. Another learned Single Judge (Lari, J) of the Sind High Court in the case of Habib Khan Vs. The Federation of Pakistan reported in PLD 1954 Sind, 199 following the aforesaid decision of the Privy Council reported in AIR 1948 FC 121= PLD 1948 PC 150 held that a suit for declaration that the order of the plaintiffs removal from service was void and inoperative and that the plaintiff remained in service was maintainable without any prayer for further relief. 

 In the result, the appeal is allowed with cost. The judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge are set aside and the suit is decreed on contest with costs, and it is hereby declared that the dismissal of the plaintiff from the post of Senior Principal Officer of the Agrani Bank was illegal, void and inoperative and that he remained in service in that post at the date of institution of the suit.
